### Fixes
- A backup could start in the middle of a restore and save half-restored data. Backups, both automatic and manual, now wait until a restore has finished.
- While a restore is running, the background job no longer checks for a wipe. Before, the storage being swapped could look like a wipe.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.loginkeeper_1.0.2_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Discoverium or `ares-install`. Open the app once afterwards so the background job picks up the new script.
